# Unlimited Copies Takaka

> Commercial printer and copy shop in Takaka, Golden Bay, Tasman, New Zealand. Printing, photocopying, scanning, finishing, business cards, posters, and higher-quality prints. Also New Zealand Couriers and Post Haste agent ($2 pickup; street address on Commercial Street — not Rural Delivery), and vacuum cleaner bags in store.

- Website: https://unlimitedcopies.co.nz/
- Email: ulc@actrix.co.nz
- Phone: +64 3 525 8355
- Address: 29 Commercial Street, Takaka 7110, New Zealand
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; closed weekends
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Unlimited-Copies-100050000846281/

## Services

- **Commercial printing in Takaka** — digital colour and black-and-white printing, photocopying, scanning, laminating, and finishing; business cards, flyers, booklets, posters, and higher-quality prints up to SRA3
- **Business cards Takaka** — in-house business card printing for Golden Bay
- **Poster printing Golden Bay** — posters and photo-quality prints up to SRA3
- **Courier pickup in Takaka** — agents for New Zealand Couriers and Post Haste; address parcels c/o Unlimited Copies, 29 Commercial Street, Takaka; $2 pickup fee; street address (not RD) often avoids Rural Delivery surcharges
- **Vacuum cleaner bags** — replacement bags and filters in-store (vac-pac, Miele, and other common brands) for Takaka / Golden Bay / Nelson–Tasman
- **The GB Weekly** — local newspaper agent ([gbweekly.co.nz](https://www.gbweekly.co.nz/))
- **Golden Bay Community Directory** — annual local phone book updates (supports Takaka Rugby Football Club); free to update details and list a cell number

## Contact

Prefer email for print jobs and file attachments: ulc@actrix.co.nz

Use the contact form on the website to send a message with attachments. The print enquiry builder can pre-fill job details (prices confirmed in shop; online pricelist later).

**Not an RD address** — 29 Commercial Street, Takaka is a town street address suitable for courier pickup without Rural Delivery surcharges.
